title: CAF-Score: Calibrating CLAP with LALMs for Reference-free Audio-Text Alignment Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2603.19615v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have advanced audio understanding and generation, robustly evaluating audio-text alignment remains difficult: reference-based metrics require costly annotations, while Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP)-based reference-free metrics frequently overlook syntactic errors and fine-grained details. We propose CAF-Score, a reference-free metric that calibrates CLAP's coarse-grained semantic alignment with the fine-grained comprehension and syntactic awareness of LALMs. Because CAF-Score scores an audio-text pair symmetrically, one configuration applies to both alignment directions: audio captioning evaluation (the BRACE benchmark) and text-to-audio (TTA) generation evaluation (the RELATE and PAM benchmarks), with a single fusion weight selected once on BRACE and transferred without re-tuning. translated_title: CAF-Score：利用大型音频-语言模型校准CLAP以实现无参考的音频-文本对齐评估
translated_abstract: 尽管大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）已经推动了音频理解与生成的发展，但如何稳健地评估音频-文本对齐仍然十分困难：基于参考的指标需要昂贵的标注，而基于对比语言-音频预训练（CLAP）的无参考指标则经常忽略句法错误和细粒度细节。我们提出了CAF-Score，这是一种无参考指标，它将CLAP的粗粒度语义对齐能力与LALMs的细粒度理解和句法感知能力相结合进行校准。由于CAF-Score以对称的方式对音频-文本对进行评分，因此一种配置即可适用于两个对齐方向：音频描述评估（BRACE基准）以及文本到音频（TTA）生成评估（RELATE和PAM基准），其中单一的融合权重只需在BRACE上选择一次，即可无需重新调参地迁移到其他基准。在所有三个人工标注的基准上，CAF-Score都提高了与人类判断的一致性。
tldr: CAF-Score是一种无参考的音频-文本对齐评估指标，它将CLAP的粗粒度语义对齐与大型音频-语言模型（LALM）的细粒度理解和句法感知能力校准融合，凭借对称评分机制，单一配置即可同时适用于音频描述和文本到音频生成两个评估方向，并在三个人工标注基准上取得与人类判断更高的一致性。
en_tdlr: CAF-Score is a reference-free audio-text alignment metric that calibrates CLAP's coarse-grained semantic alignment with the fine-grained comprehension and syntactic awareness of LALMs, and its symmetric scoring allows a single configuration to serve both audio captioning and text-to-audio evaluation, achieving improved agreement with human judgments across three annotated benchmarks.
